configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server to be displayed in the server list

configurationFields.label: Serverbeschreibung
configurationFields.description: Sets a description of the server to be displayed in the server list

configurationFields.label: Server Tags
configurationFields.description: Comma separated list of up to 5 server tags to display in the server list. Available tags: 0 (PvP), 1 (PvE), 2 (EXP Multiplier), 3 (Gathering Rate), 4 (Keep Inventory), 5 (45 day wipe), 6 (15 day wipe), 7 (30 day wipe), 8 (60 day wipe)

configurationFields.label: Server ID
configurationFields.description: Sets a unique ID for the server. Default = random 8 digit number

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Server Admins
configurationFields.description: Semi-colon separated list of [Steam64 IDs](https://steamid.io/) of server admins

configurationFields.label: Show Admin Icon
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the special admin icon will be shown

configurationFields.label: Enable Anticheat
configurationFields.description: If set, the server's anticheat system will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Server Wipe Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the next date on which all server data will be wiped. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

configurationFields.label: Server Framerate
configurationFields.description: Sets the server framerate

configurationFields.label: Autosave Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the server autosave interval

configurationFields.label: Daily Backups Quantity
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of backups performed by the server each day

configurationFields.label: Backups Retention Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the period after which a backup will be overwritten by new backups

configurationFields.label: Use Steam Socket
configurationFields.description: If enabled, Steam servers will be used for network penetration. Enable this if you don't have a public IP but want to allow players from outside your network to join the server. DON'T enable this if you have a public IP. This setting will impact server latency

configurationFields.label: Out IP Address Selection Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether GSCS should automatically select the public IP advertised as the OutIPAddress for the server, or whether it should use the IP set under Server Public IP

configurationFields.label: Server Public IP
configurationFields.description: Sets the public IP advertised for the server, if "Manual" is selected as the Out IP Address Selection Mode. Useful if the host network has multiple public IPs, or the server is behind a public proxy

configurationFields.label: Additional Command Line Parameters
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional command line parameters that are not otherwise set by GSCS. ONE LINE ONLY! Use with care

configurationFields.label: Enable PvE / Disable PvP
configurationFields.description: If set, PvE mode will be enabled, and PvP mode disabled. In PvP mode, players can attack other players and their structures. In PvE mode they cannot

configurationFields.label: Allow Damage To Self
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can damage themselves

configurationFields.label: Allow Damage To Allies
configurationFields.description: If enabled, squadmates can damage each other

configurationFields.label: Enable Realistic Vehicle Physics
configurationFields.description: If enabled, realistic physics behaviour will apply to vehicles, stopping them drifting on corners

configurationFields.label: Maximum Squad Size
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of members allowed for each squad

configurationFields.label: Item Stack Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the stack limit for each type of item

configurationFields.label: Unlock All Recipes And Talents
configurationFields.description: When enabled, all recipes and talents will be unlocked for new characters

configurationFields.label: Starting Inventory Size
configurationFields.description: Sets how many inventory slots a new character gets by default

configurationFields.label: Enable Novice Protection
configurationFields.description: If enabled, new characters will receive novice protection

configurationFields.label: Items On Respawn
configurationFields.description: Semi-colon separated list of items a character gets on respawn. Format: ItemID, Quality, Amount

configurationFields.label: Drop Items On Death
configurationFields.description: Sets the mode for dropping items on death

options.2: Drop inventory (not equipped or hotkey items)

configurationFields.label: Dropped Items Despawn
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of time after which items dropped on death will disappear

configurationFields.label: Corpse Loot Permissions
configurationFields.description: Sets which players can loot corpses

configurationFields.label: Enable Creatures/Structures Drop
configurationFields.description: If enabled, creatures and structures will drop items when killed/destroyed

configurationFields.label: Allow Item Discard
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can discard items

configurationFields.label: Discarded Items Despawn
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of time after which items discarded will disappear

configurationFields.label: Initial Respawn Cooldown
configurationFields.description: Sets the basic (or starting) revival cooldown duration

configurationFields.label: Respawn Cooldown Penalty
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of time by which the revival cooldown increases after multiple deaths

configurationFields.label: Death Penalty Stack Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of death cooldown penalties to be applied

configurationFields.label: Death Penalties Respawn Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time after which stacked revival cooldowns are reset

configurationFields.label: Enable Structure Decay
configurationFields.description: If enabled, structures will decay

configurationFields.label: Friendly Name Display Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum distance at which a player can see a squadmate's name

configurationFields.label: Non-friendly Name Display Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum distance at which a player can see a non-squadmate's name

configurationFields.label: NPC Name Display Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum distance at which a player can see an NPC's name

configurationFields.label: Show All Spacetime Beacons
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the location of other players' beacons will be displayed on the map

configurationFields.label: Allow Chat Including Voice
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be able to send chat messages in-game

configurationFields.label: Enable Blood Effects
configurationFields.description: If enabled, blood effects will appear when damaged

configurationFields.label: Allow Profanity
configurationFields.description: If set, the profanity filter will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Wounded State
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the wounded state will be triggered when HP falls to 0, rather than the player immediately dying

configurationFields.label: Monster NPC Corpse Despawn
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of time after which animal NPC corpses will disappear

configurationFields.label: Human NPC Corpse Despawn
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of time after which human NPC corpses will disappear

configurationFields.label: Player Beacon Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of beacons each player can build

configurationFields.label: Beacon Trap Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of traps that can be within beacon coverage

configurationFields.label: Beacon Turret Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of turrets that can be within beacon coverage

configurationFields.label: Beacon Daily Non-Protection Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of time daily that beacons can be attacked

configurationFields.label: All Monster Respawn Time Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the time before dead wild NPCs can respawn

configurationFields.label: Monster Raid Cooldown Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the cooldown time between supply deliveries

configurationFields.label: Heat Resistance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for character heat resistance

configurationFields.label: Cold Resistance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for character cold resistance

configurationFields.label: Inventory Item Durability Death Penalty
configurationFields.description: On death, the durability of equipped items will fall by the maximum durability multiplied by this amount (does not affect drops)

configurationFields.label: Hotbar Item Durability Death Penalty
configurationFields.description: On death, the durability of hotbar items will fall by the maximum durability multiplied by this amount (does not affect drops)

configurationFields.label: Crafting/Repair Time Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the item crafting/repair time

configurationFields.label: All XP Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for all XP earned

configurationFields.label: Kill XP Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for XP earned from killing monsters

configurationFields.label: Collection XP Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for XP earned from collecting resources

configurationFields.label: Crafting XP Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for XP earned from crafting items

configurationFields.label: Movement Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for movement speed

configurationFields.label: Jump Height Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for jump height

configurationFields.label: Fall Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for damage taken from falls

configurationFields.label: HP Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for maximum HP

configurationFields.label: HP Recovery Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount by which HP recovery will be multiplied

configurationFields.label: Maximum Stamina Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for maximum stamina

configurationFields.label: Stamina Recovery Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount by which stamina recovery will be multiplied

configurationFields.label: Stamina Loss Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the stamina consumption speed

configurationFields.label: Maximum Fullness Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for maximum fullness

configurationFields.label: Fullness Loss Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the fullness consumption speed

configurationFields.label: Fullness From Food Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of fullness recovered by eating

configurationFields.label: Maximum Hydration Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for maximum hydration

configurationFields.label: Hydration Loss Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the hydration consumption speed

configurationFields.label: Hydration From Water Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of hydration recovered by drinking

configurationFields.label: Maximum Oxygen Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for maximum oxygen

configurationFields.label: Oxygen Recovery Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount by which oxygen recovery will be multiplied

configurationFields.label: Oxygen Loss Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the oxygen consumption speed

configurationFields.label: Medication HP Recovery Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of HP recovered from medication

configurationFields.label: Food And Medication Effect Duration Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier applied to the duration of effect of food and medication

configurationFields.label: Wild NPC Corpse Drop Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of items dropped by a wild NPC on death

configurationFields.label: Wild NPC Starting Level Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the starting level of wild NPCs, making them more powerful

configurationFields.label: Wild NPC Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the damage dealt by wild NPCs

configurationFields.label: Wild NPC HP Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the HP of wild NPCs. Minimum is 0.1

configurationFields.label: Wild NPC Movement Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the movement speed of wild NPCs. Minimum is 0.1

configurationFields.label: Raid NPC Level Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the level of raid NPCs, making them more powerful

configurationFields.label: Raid NPC Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the damage dealt by raid NPCs

configurationFields.label: Raid NPC HP Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the HP of raid NPCs. Minimum is 0.1

configurationFields.label: Raid NPC Movement Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the movement speed of raid NPCs. Minimum is 0.1

configurationFields.label: Raid NPC Amount Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the total number of raid NPCs summoned each round. Minimum is 0.1

configurationFields.label: Collectible Resource Spawn Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of resources received upon collection

configurationFields.label: Raid Corpse Drop Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of items dropped by a raid NPC upon death

configurationFields.label: Player Work-Type Structures Limit Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the maximum number of work-type structures each player can build

configurationFields.label: Non-Trap Structure Damage Resistance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets multiplier for the damage taken by structures other than traps, turrets and beacons

configurationFields.label: Trap Damage Resistance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the damage taken by traps

configurationFields.label: Turret Damage Resistance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the damage taken by turrets

configurationFields.label: Trap Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the damage dealt by traps

configurationFields.label: Turret Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the damage dealt by turrets

configurationFields.label: Structure Durability Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the maximum durability of structures. Minimum is 0.1

configurationFields.label: Structure Durability Recovery Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the durability recovery speed of placed structures

configurationFields.label: Spacetime Beacon Auto-repair Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the durability recovery speed of structures within the auto-repair range of a beacon

configurationFields.label: Oil Well Work Production Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for resources collected from oil wells

configurationFields.label: Dew Collector Work Production Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for resources collected from dew collectors

configurationFields.label: Mine Work Production Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for resources collected from mines

configurationFields.label: Fish Basket Work Production Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for resources collected from fish baskets

configurationFields.label: Beacon Player Gun Damage Resistance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the damage that beacons take from player firearms

configurationFields.label: Beacon Player Vehicle Damage Resistance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the damage that beacons take from player vehicles

configurationFields.label: Beacon NPC Damage Resistance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the damage that beacons take from NPCs

configurationFields.label: Resource Collection Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the maximum gains from collection. This value must be bigger than other collection multipliers

configurationFields.label: Wood Production Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of wood collected

configurationFields.label: Plant Production Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of plants collected

configurationFields.label: Ore Production Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of ore collected

configurationFields.label: Crop Production Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of crops collected

configurationFields.label: Animal Production Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of items collected from corpses

configurationFields.label: Crop Growth Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the growth speed of planted crops

configurationFields.label: Melee Damage Vs NPC Multipler
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for melee weapon damage that characters deal to NPCs

configurationFields.label: Ranged Damage Vs NPC Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for ranged weapon damage that characters deal to NPCs

configurationFields.label: Melee PvP Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for melee weapon damage that characters deal to players

configurationFields.label: Ranged PvP Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for ranged weapon damage that characters deal to players

configurationFields.label: Melee Damage Vs Structure Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for melee weapon damage that characters deal to structures

configurationFields.label: Ranged Damage Vs Structure Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for ranged weapon damage that characters deal to structures

configurationFields.label: Collection Tool Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the damage that tools deal to resources

configurationFields.label: Durability Loss Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the durability lost when using tools, weapons and armour

configurationFields.label: Vehicle Vs Player Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of damage vehicles deal to players

configurationFields.label: Vehicle Vs Structure Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of damage vehicles deal to structures

configurationFields.label: Vehicle Collection Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for the amount of resources collected by vehicles
